entities.summary: Killi Krupa Rani is an Indian politician from Andhra Pradesh. She is a former member of the Indian Parliament and previously represented Srikakulam from 2009 to 2014. She belongs to Kalinga caste. In April 2024, she resigned from YSRCP and joined the Indian National Congress.
